Former Reliance Capital CFO Arrested in Probe into Group Cases

The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has taken former Reliance Capital Limited CFO Amit Bapna into custody in connection with an ongoing probe into Reliance ADA Group cases. Bapna, who served as CFO from August 2014 to December 2019, is alleged by the agency to have been a key decision-maker in the company's financial management.
